name: Roast Turkey Dinner for Two with Bacon, Sweet Potatoes, Cauliflower & Gravy

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE TURKEY & VEGGIES: About 2 hours before you plan to serve the turkey, set the turkey breast on the counter and allow it to come to room temperature, about 30 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small pkg fresh rosemary
¾ lb sweet potato
½ medium head cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Slide rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel sweet potato, then cut lengthwise into 1-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the rosemary.
Separate cauliflower into large florets. Add to the bowl.
Small dice bacon, then add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to coat, then transfer to a large baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 slice bacon
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat turkey breast dry with paper towels. Add to the baking dish, nestling it into the veggies, then rub with additional oil and season with more salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven and roast until the veggies start to soften and turkey starts to turn golden, about 20 minutes.

Remove baking dish from the oven. Sprinkle capers over the veggies, stir to combine, and return dish to the oven. Continue to roast until the veggies are tender and turkey reaches 165°F, 30 minutes more.
When the turkey and veggies are done, remove from the oven, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and let rest for 10-15 minutes.
FOR THE GRAVY: Meanwhile, preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
0.06 tsp salt
0.06 tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add flour to the pan and cook, stirring often, until starting to turn golden, about 1 minute.
Add broth to the pan in a thin steady stream, while whisking constantly. Continue to cook, whisking often, until thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: TO SERVE: Thinly slice turkey, then transfer to a serving platter along with the veggies. Serve with gravy on the side. Enjoy!
